notes: This is the full version of the chart that was cropped in IMG_7814 (same quote 71,866.4 +1,339.8 +1.90%, same phone status bar 5:03 / 5G / battery 5). The last-price label is unambiguous here: teal box reading '71,866.4' with the bar countdown '26:57' beneath it - which retroactively confirms the same price-then-countdown layout used in IMG_7812. A red price tag sits directly above 89,239.5 but its digits are clipped by the top edge of the embedded screenshot, so it is not recorded. The solid green line was initially hard to assign because the 69,361.4 and 69,011.1 tags collide; resolved by pixel interpolation against the three cyan dashed lines (85,126.6 at y=542, 74,577.3 at y=796, 62,694.3 at y=1080 in the original image, 41.70 price/px): the green line sits at y=927.5 = 69,052, i.e. the light-green 69,011.1 tag, and 89,027.3 is confirmed as a second green line at y=449. 69,361.4 is a separate red level with no line of its own. Faint watchlist rows 'PUMPUS...' and 'AVAXUS...' bleed through behind the footer. The greyed quote line above the 00:49 message is a reply-reference to the 25/03 20:44 message, not a new statement. '26 March 2026' is a day divider. Reaction: 👍 2.
